relationships.subject: Nabiximols
relationships.evidence_quote: Nabiximols has undergone larger and more robust clinical trials than other cannabis-based products or medication for use in pain

relationships.subject: THC
relationships.evidence_quote: There was moderate-quality evidence for cannabinoids having a small effect in treating chronic, non-cancer-related pain at all time points studied, up to 6 months.

relationships.subject: THC
relationships.evidence_quote: The nine available studies suggested that cannabis was effective, as an adjunct to opioids, in reducing the dosage of opioids in study participants.

key_findings: Review of cannabinoid formulations and delivery routes for pain; meta-analyses show small but significant analgesic effects of THC-based cannabinoids in chronic non-cancer pain.
Cannabinoids may reduce opioid dosage, though study designs are limited; nano-formulations remain preliminary.
